name: zzRG2_snake

tests.name: the python's body is readable segment by segment

detail.note: follow-through is a claim about the body; only the head was exposed before this

tests.name: the head travelled far enough around the brain for coverage to mean anything

detail.note: THE CONTROL. Angle turned, not distance moved: the radius springs in and out on its own, so a head bobbing on the spot covers distance without going anywhere. Below the floor the coverage reading below cannot distinguish a route that avoids the back from a route that was watched in slow motion, and those want opposite fixes.

tests.name: the head goes in front, behind, above and below the brain

detail.note: each axis judged against its OWN reach, so a route that is naturally wider than it is tall is not failed for it

tests.name: each segment arrives where the one ahead of it has already been

detail.note: the lag at which a segment best matches the one ahead. A rigid body swung on a stick matches at lag 0 and would pass every existing check

tests.name: the tail travels its own distance rather than being dragged rigidly

detail.note: a rigid ring's tail travels exactly as far as its head; a real body's does not
